fs_hz.label: Resonant frequency
fs_hz.help: Frequency at which the cone resonates in free air, without a box.

qts.label: Total Q
qts.help: Total damping of the driver at resonance; combines electrical and mechanical losses.

qes.label: Electrical Q
qes.help: Share of the damping that comes from the motor (voice coil and magnet).

qms.label: Mechanical Q
qms.help: Share of the damping that comes from the suspension (spider and surround).

vas_m3.label: Equivalent volume
vas_m3.help: Volume of air with the same stiffness as the cone suspension.

re_ohm.label: Coil resistance
re_ohm.help: Electrical resistance of the voice coil measured at DC.

le_h.label: Coil inductance
le_h.help: Inductance of the voice coil, which reduces the response at high frequencies.

xmax_m.label: Maximum excursion
xmax_m.help: Largest one-way cone displacement that still behaves linearly.

sd_m2.label: Cone area
sd_m2.help: Effective area that moves air, usually including half of the surround.

pe_w.label: Thermal power
pe_w.help: Power the driver handles continuously without overheating.

bl_tm.label: Force factor
bl_tm.help: Motor strength: magnetic field times the length of wire in the coil.

mms_kg.label: Moving mass
mms_kg.help: Mass of the moving assembly, including the air it carries.

vb_m3.label: Box volume
vb_m3.help: Gross internal box volume; driver and port volumes are subtracted in the calculation.

vr_m3.label: Rear chamber volume (sealed)
vr_m3.help: Gross volume of the sealed chamber behind the cone, before subtracting the driver.

vf_m3.label: Front chamber volume (ported)
vf_m3.help: Gross volume of the chamber in front of the cone, where the port is, before subtracting the port.

fb_hz.label: Port tuning
fb_hz.help: Frequency at which the port and the box volume resonate together.

fb_rear_hz.label: Rear chamber tuning
fb_rear_hz.help: Frequency at which the rear chamber and its port resonate with the cone blocked.

vd_m3.label: Motor volume — M-Vd
vd_m3.help: Volume the motor and basket take up inside the box (datasheet). It is subtracted from the internal volume. Leave 0 if unknown.

ql.label: Box losses (Ql)
ql.help: Leakage and absorption losses. 7 is typical for a well-sealed box; lower means more loss.

diameter_m.label: Port diameter
diameter_m.help: Inner diameter of each round port.

width_m.label: Port width
width_m.help: Inner width of each rectangular port.

height_m.label: Port height
height_m.help: Inner height of each rectangular or triangular port.

base_m.label: Port base
base_m.help: Inner base of each triangular port.

rear_diameter_m.label: Rear port diameter
rear_diameter_m.help: Inside diameter of each round port of the rear chamber.

rear_width_m.label: Rear port width
rear_width_m.help: Inside width of each rectangular port of the rear chamber.

rear_height_m.label: Rear port height
rear_height_m.help: Inside height of each rectangular or triangular port of the rear chamber.

rear_base_m.label: Rear port base
rear_base_m.help: Inside base of each triangular port of the rear chamber.

port_count.label: Number of ports
port_count.help: Number of identical ports in the box.

rear_port_count.label: Number of rear ports
rear_port_count.help: Number of identical ports in the rear chamber.

driver_count.label: Number of drivers
driver_count.help: Number of identical drivers in the same box.

power_w.label: Input power
power_w.help: Electrical power applied to the set, referred to the resistance Re.

voltage_v.label: Input voltage
voltage_v.help: RMS voltage applied to the set's terminals.

thickness_m.label: Panel thickness
thickness_m.help: Thickness of the wood sheet used for the panels and the divider.

braces_m3.label: Bracing volume
braces_m3.help: Total volume of the internal bracing. The box gets bigger by this volume so the net volume stays the project one.

cutout_m.label: Diameter C — cutout
cutout_m.help: Hole in the wood for the loudspeaker (the same field as in the cut plan). Round: diameter; square: side; rectangular: first size.

ratio_h.label: Ratio — height
ratio_h.help: Weight of the height in the height : width : depth ratio.

ratio_w.label: Ratio — width
ratio_w.help: Weight of the width in the height : width : depth ratio.

ratio_d.label: Ratio — depth
ratio_d.help: Weight of the depth in the height : width : depth ratio.

sheet_w_m.label: Sheet width
sheet_w_m.help: Width of the MDF sheet you have to cut (for example 2.75 m). Thickness is the panel thickness.

sheet_h_m.label: Sheet height
sheet_h_m.help: Height of the MDF sheet you have to cut (for example 1.85 m).

kerf_m.label: Saw kerf
kerf_m.help: Width the saw removes on each cut, usually about 3 mm. The system leaves this gap between pieces.

sheet_quantity.label: Quantity
sheet_quantity.help: How many sheets of this size you have. Leave blank if you can buy as many as needed.

cutpos_x_m.label: Center — distance from left edge
cutpos_x_m.help: Distance from the panel's left edge to the cutout center, looking at the panel from the front.

cutpos_y_m.label: Center — distance from bottom edge
cutpos_y_m.help: Distance from the panel's bottom edge to the cutout center, looking at the panel from the front.

dim_h_m.label: Inner size — height
dim_h_m.help: Inner height of the box. Editing one measure adjusts the other two so the volume stays the same.

dim_w_m.label: Inner size — width
dim_w_m.help: Inner width of the box. Editing one measure adjusts the other two so the volume stays the same.

dim_d_m.label: Inner size — depth
dim_d_m.help: Inner depth of the box. Editing one measure adjusts the other two so the volume stays the same.

drv_a_m.label: Diameter A — outer frame
drv_a_m.help: Outer diameter of the loudspeaker frame (basket), measured edge to edge. Used to check the fit in the box.

drv_b_m.label: Diameter B — cone
drv_b_m.help: Cone diameter, measured at the outer edge of the surround.

drv_d_m.label: Size D — second side
drv_d_m.help: Second side of the cutout when the loudspeaker is rectangular (the first is size C).

drv_e_m.label: Depth E — magnet
drv_e_m.help: Depth of the magnet (motor) assembly, from the back of the basket to the end of the magnet.

drv_f_m.label: Depth F — flange
drv_f_m.help: Thickness of the flange in front of the baffle. What goes inside the box is the total depth minus this.

drv_g_m.label: Depth G — total
drv_g_m.help: Total loudspeaker depth, from the front of the flange to the end of the magnet. If it exceeds the box internal depth, the cut plan warns you.
